# TERREOAK Landscaping & Snow

> TERREOAK is an owner-operated landscape construction, property maintenance and residential snow removal company in Calgary, Alberta, Canada. Phone (587) 707-7648, email services@terreoak.ca. Open 7 days a week, 6am to 9pm.

## Services

- [Residential snow removal](https://terreoak.ca/residential-snow-removal): flat-rate season passes for driveways and front sidewalks in southwest and southeast Calgary. Service at 1cm of accumulation, once every 24 hours during a snowfall (a full route is cleared in 12 hours on average), with dispatch alerts and a photo log after every visit.
- [Commercial grounds maintenance](https://terreoak.ca/commercial-grounds-maintenance): year-round grounds care and snow and ice management for condo corporations, HOAs, industrial and business parks, and builders.
- [Landscape installs](https://terreoak.ca/landscape-installs): design and build, with typical Calgary price ranges.
- [Hardscaping](https://terreoak.ca/hardscaping): paving stone patios, retaining walls, walkways, steps, grading and drainage.
- [Softscapes](https://terreoak.ca/softscapes): sod, garden beds, tree and shrub planting, mulch and topsoil.
- [Spring cleanup](https://terreoak.ca/spring-cleanup-calgary): core aeration, power raking and debris removal.
- [Fall cleanup](https://terreoak.ca/fall-cleanup): leaf removal, final mow and winter lawn prep.
- [Irrigation blowouts](https://terreoak.ca/irrigation-blowouts): sprinkler system winterization.
